cloakroom: Safe cloakrooms and locker facility are available near the entrance counters to deposit bags, footwear, and mobile devices before joining the darshan queue lines.
drinking_water: Water distribution and refreshment stations serve visitors throughout the complex.
toilets: Accessible restroom layouts are integrated within the main premises.
footwear_counter: Designated footwear stand outside the inner temple courtyard.
annadanam: Nitya Annadanam: Free holy lunch meals are served daily to all visiting pilgrims in the designated dining halls during the afternoon hours.
wheelchair_accessibility: Flat ground access with level main pathways and courtyard suitable for personal wheelchairs and walking frames. Accessible parking spaces, ramp paths, and direct logistical assistance paths to ensure minimal standing times for senior citizens.
parking: Devasthanam Parking Lot: A broad, open parking space handles cars, bikes, and tourist buses. Standard vehicle entry parking tickets are priced under 100 rupees. Accessible parking spaces available.
other_facilities: Hemalapuri Sadan: Official temple-managed guest house located close to the main complex. Rooms can be booked by directly contacting the management desk at +91 79899 93291.

Jogulamba River Ghat: Located on the banks of the adjacent Tungabhadra River, structured with steps and safety railings for devotees wishing to take a traditional holy purification bath before prayers.
Changing Rooms: Dedicated separate changing enclosures for men and women available directly near the river bathing points.
Queue Assistance: Security staff and temple guards are available along the barricades to physically assist and guide frail devotees.
Vehicle Drop-Off: Cars can drive down Temple Road to drop senior citizens directly at the main entrance gate before parking.
